prompt: Perform a thorough source-only security review of the OWASP Juice Shop application at C:\Users\User\Projects\web-security-audit-workspace\juice-shop. Review frontend, backend, generated APIs, shared security and configuration. Report evidenced root causes with file/line anchors, bounded impact, remediation and regression checks; distinguish source proof from unverified runtime assumptions. Record reviewed and unreviewed scope. Do not start the application or test deployed services. Save a complete Markdown report, no arbitrary finding cap.
